features.title:
Everything in one place,
delivered everywhere
features.subtitle: A complete knowledge infrastructure — from ingestion to delivery.

singleHub.title: Single Knowledge Hub
singleHub.desc: All company documents, policies, CRM data and wikis unified in one AI-searchable place. No more hunting through folders or asking colleagues.

integrations.title: Deep Integrations
integrations.desc: Pull data live from Bitrix24, 1C ERP, Confluence, SharePoint, Google Drive and any REST source. Knowledge stays fresh automatically.

aiAgent.title: AI Agent Delivery
aiAgent.desc: Deploy WikiAI as an AI agent in your Telegram bot, website chat, Slack workspace, or online store. Answers driven by your real company data.

semanticSearch.title: Semantic Search
semanticSearch.desc: Ask questions in natural language. Vector embeddings understand meaning, not just keywords. Get ranked answers with source citations.

multiDepartment.title: Multi-Department
multiDepartment.desc: Separate knowledge bases per department or subsidiary with full data isolation. Marketing, Sales, Tech — each with their own space.

analytics.title: Usage Analytics
analytics.desc: See which questions employees ask most. Identify knowledge gaps. Track adoption and measure ROI of your knowledge base investment.

employeeJourney.title: Every role gets answers in seconds
employeeJourney.subtitle: From a first-day hire to a seasoned VP — WikiAI understands context of question and searches across every document, database, and system your company uses.
knowledgeTypes: HR policies, contracts, and onboarding guides
Live CRM and ERP data via integrations

integrationHub.title: Connect your systems. Deliver anywhere.
integrationHub.subtitle: WikiAI sits at center of your tech stack — pulling from every source, pushing answers to every channel.

detailCards.bitrix24: Sync CRM contacts, deals, tasks and company wikis in real-time.

detailCards.messaging: Deploy a bot that answers in your team chats, powered by company knowledge.
detailCards.store: Embed a support agent that answers product and policy questions on your shop.

faq.answer2: We'll notify you when you're approaching your limits. You can upgrade your plan or purchase additional storage/users as needed.
faq.question3: Do you offer discounts for non-profits?
faq.answer3: Yes, we offer a 50% discount for qualified non-profit organizations. Contact our sales team for more information.
faq.answer4: Absolutely. We use enterprise-grade encryption, regular security audits, and comply with GDPR, SOC 2, and other major compliance standards.
faq.question5: Can I try before I buy?
